launches.title: Manufact: MCP Cloud for your Claude Connector & ChatGPT Plugin
launches.tagline: Get your product on Claude and ChatGPT and usable by AI Agents
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we're the team behind [**mcp-use**](https://github.com/mcp-use/mcp-use), the open-source MCP framework with **10k GitHub stars** and **\~10M+ downloads**.

[**Manufact**](https://manufact.com/) is the cloud platform that gets your product onto the **Claude Connectors marketplace** and the **ChatGPT (Codex) Plugin Store** via MCP.

<https://youtu.be/Pyh_3tKDXuU>

## The problem

Paul Graham recently tweeted: "_AI apps are the new browsers_". \
Your customers now do most of their work inside Claude and ChatGPT, and the connector marketplaces are a new distribution channel: someone installs your product in one click and uses it inside the chat they already live in.

We listed Manufact on Claude and saw a **surge of signups** that is still going on now.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107462&key=user_uploads/859771/65a0b3fd-75cf-4eea-a2ee-02590e3256ba)

But shipping a production-ready MCP server is its own project:

* MCP is a protocol evolving fast .
* Auth is easy to get [wrong](https://manufact.com/blog/authentication).
* Every client behaves differently.
* The stores have their own conformance requirements, and review can block you for weeks.

## How Manufact works

Manufact is the cloud built specifically for MCP:

* **Push to deploy.** Connect the GitHub App once and [every commit ships a new version of your MCP server](https://manufact.com/platform/hosting), with a preview deployment for each PR.
* **Test every MCP tool and MCP-UI widget** in the [cloud inspector](https://manufact.com/platform/cloud-inspector).
* **Know the moment your MCP breaks** in ChatGPT or Claude with [automatic cross-client testing](https://manufact.com/platform/cross-client-testing).
* [**Publishing checklists**](https://manufact.com/platform/publishing-checks) so your MCP app doesn't get stuck in marketplace review.
* **Auto-generated submission assets** (logo, copy, screenshots).
* **Analytics, session replay, and traces** built in for MCP, so you can see [how it's used and why tools fail](https://manufact.com/platform/analytics).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107462&key=user_uploads/859771/ee30e016-9fb5-4958-890f-74febc54de3c)

## Your product's UI inside the chat

A plain MCP server lets the agent read and write your data. \
An **MCP App** goes further: it's an MCP server that can return a UI as the result of a tool call, so your actual product interface renders inside Claude or ChatGPT. The user sees your charts and forms instead of a wall of text.

Ferruccio Balestreri (Amplitude) [put it well](https://x.com/0xferruccio/status/2028966278971670979):

> since mcp ui was released in claude we got a 2x boost in retention.

With the [mcp-use SDK](https://github.com/mcp-use/mcp-use) you write a normal React component, drop it in, and it registers as an MCP UI resource automatically.

## Backstory

We've been building on MCP since the protocol shipped. It started with the mcp-use SDK, the full-stack framework for MCP servers and apps. We kept watching companies struggle to take those servers to production, so we built the cloud for it (mcp-use is to Manufact what Next.js is to Vercel).

Manufact is now the **#1 recommended deployment option in OpenAI's docs.** 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107462&key=user_uploads/859771/ddba2350-67c4-43d5-8150-30847d4375a2)

We've helped startups from recent YC batches like **AgentMail** and **Item** get onto the Claude Connectors marketplace, and larger companies in finance, insurance, and marketplaces run their MCP apps on Manufact in production.

## Our asks

1. Have an MCP server? **Deploy it on [Manufact](https://manufact.com/)**.
2. Thinking about building an MCP App? [Copy our prompt for agents](https://manufact.com/prompt.md) and your coding agent will guide you.
3. Trying to get listed on the marketplaces? [Book a call with us](https://cal.com/team/manufact/chat). We have publishing checks and direct contacts on the MCP teams at Anthropic and OpenAI.

Hope to see your MCP on [manufact.com](http://manufact.com), or that you at least learned something new. 🙂

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107462&key=user_uploads/859771/685643a6-ecd5-42b4-b55f-ec394967ca57)

launches.title: Manufact (mcp-use) - Build and deploy MCP Servers for AI Agents & MCP Apps for ChatGPT / Claude users
launches.tagline: Create MCP servers/apps in minutes, connect your GitHub repo, and make them immediately available to AI agents and ChatGPT / Claude.
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

[Manufact](https://manufact.com) is the MCP cloud for dev teams to ship MCP Apps and Servers in production. Connect a GitHub repo and Manufact handles deployment, security, observability, and scaling, so teams can ship in minutes instead of weeks.

One codebase, deployed everywhere users and agents already live: the ChatGPT Apps Store, Claude Connectors, Gemini, Cursor, Claude Code, and more.

We're also the creators of [mcp-use SDK](https://github.com/mcp-use/mcp-use), the most popular high-level MCP framework for building MCP Apps and Servers.\
(mcp-use SDK is to the Model Context Protocol SDKs what Next.js is to React!)

It’s open-source and used by developers at 20% of US500 and companies like 6sense, Elastic, IBM, Innovacer, Intuit, NVIDIA, Oracle, Red Hat, Tavily, and Verizon are building with us.

### **The ask**

If you're building MCP Apps or Servers, or you know someone who is, we'd love to talk.

<https://cal.com/team/manufact/chat> \
or shoot a message to us: +1 (628) 899-2498 \
or [founders@manufact.com](mailto:founders@manufact.com)

### **Our story**

When MCP came out, we couldn't believe such a powerful protocol was locked into IDEs and Claude Desktop.

So we built mcp-use, the open source framework that lets any developer build MCP Apps and Servers in code, in a structured and composable way.

It got adopted fast: 7M+ downloads across Python and TypeScript, almost 10k GitHub stars, and dev teams at top companies shipping with it.

But OSS is only half the story. Once teams had something working, they hit the wall every infra team knows: deployment, auth, secrets, observability, scaling. Stitching that together for MCP is a multi-week project. That's what Manufact solves.

### **Make something agents want**

MCP unlocks something most products have never had access to before: real estate inside ChatGPT and Claude.

800M+ users already spend their day in those chats. \
With MCP, a product can show up there as a native app or connector, with no separate UI to build, no app to install, no new login flow. \
The user just asks, and your product does the work.

### **Problem**

The catch is that "build once, ship everywhere" is its own infra problem. ChatGPT Apps, Claude Connectors, Gemini, and the long tail of agent surfaces (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenAI Agents, Mastra, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) each have their own quirks, auth flows, and submission requirements. Manufact lets you build one codebase and ship it to all of them.

### **What Manufact does**

Connect your MCP repo once. Every push auto-deploys.

1. **Build:** Scaffold a full MCP App or Server with _npx create-mcp-use-app_ or drop in existing MCP code unchanged.
2. **Deploy:** GitHub App connects once. Every push auto-deploys to Manufact Cloud. Preview URL per branch. Custom domains with SSL handled.
3. **Publish.** Get your app in front of users in the ChatGPT Apps Store and Claude Connectors. Submission assets, marketplace checklists, and an embeddable chat widget for your own site, docs, or campaign pages.
4. **Iterate.** Cloud Inspector debugs from any browser against real clients. Swap models. Run evals on every deploy.
5. **Monitor.** Analytics, session replay, JSON-RPC traces, and alerts on regressions, so you catch issues before users do. Less than 60 seconds from _git push_ to a live MCP App or Server, available across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and any agent surface that speaks MCP.

### **Ask**

Do you know anyone already using MCP servers internally or building products powered by AI agents?

For the first few companies we will personally create/integrate MCP servers you need, have everything running through our platform, either on cloud or your own infrastructure. We even help you integrate our SDK into your code.

What do you think? Can we help you?

Book a call: <https://cal.com/team/manufact/chat>

Shoot a message to us: +1 (628) 899-2498 or [founders@manufact.com](mailto:founders@manufact.com)
